summary: Most Stripe frontend requirements (config surface, upgrade CTA behavior, and success/cancel return routes) appear implemented. The “Refresh subscription status” control exists, but the diff introduces a separate profile-refresh query hook with duplicated fetch logic rather than clearly reusing the existing profile query’s refetch/invalidation pattern.

missing_requirements.requirement: Use the existing React Query profile query invalidation/refetch pattern (no duplicate profile-fetch logic) for the manual “Refresh subscription status” action.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff adds a new hook (useRefreshUserProfile) with its own queryFn that re-fetches the profile, rather than reusing the existing useGetCallerUserProfile query instance’s refetch or queryClient.invalidateQueries-driven refetch pattern. This appears to duplicate profile-fetch logic.

hallucinated_features.description: Automatically create a user profile when getCallerUserProfile returns null (auto-provisioning behavior).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any requirement (REQ-13..REQ-16 are Stripe config/upgrade/return routes/refresh). This changes backend-fetch behavior by creating state on read.

hallucinated_features.description: Added subscription tier helper utilities beyond what’s required for Stripe upgrade/refresh flow (e.g., getFallbackTierLabel, isFree, isPro).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not explicitly requested in REQ-13..REQ-16; may be useful internally but is not part of stated requirements.
